messages:
Elaine (Sales): hey team — need quick sign-off on a credit extension for NebulaX POC. security questions pushed their timeline out ~3 weeks, they're asking for extra trial credits to finish end-to-end tests.
Sam (Solutions): saw the questionnaire. main blocker is the SSO cert rotation flow + inference telemetry mask. we can gap it but they need ~300k tokens to validate throughput under their workload.
Elaine (Sales): customer is asking for $12k in credits to cover the extra run. they said if POC proves perf they'll commit to a 6mo reserved plan. want to know if we can grant now or offer a smaller bump.
Jeremy (Deals): tagging pricing. @Maria any rules for startup exceptions? normally we do a max of $5k for trial bumps without exec sign-off.
Maria (Finance): correct — standard promo cap is $5,000. above that needs RevOps/dealdesk approval + we mark as credit (contra-revenue) in billing. if there's a commit we can structure as a credit toward first invoice.
Elaine (Sales): customer is mid-market but early stage product team — commit probability ~60% if POC passes. can we do $8k conditional on a 3-6 month commit? or $5k unconditional.
Sam (Solutions): technically $300k tokens ~= $6-7k at list, but with some caching they'll need a bit less. $8k seems fair to cover spikes.
Security-bot: SECURITY CHECK: NebulaX questionnaire status = partial. Outstanding items: `SSO cert rotation`, `KV cache masking`. Please update PRD or attach test logs.
Elaine (Sales): they've promised test logs by EOW. can we approve a 3-week credit extension while we wait for logs? makes or breaks the POC timeline.
Jeremy (Deals): I'm +1 for a conditional credit: approve up to $8,000 if they sign a short MOU/commit to a 3-month reserved trial or pay a nominal first-month commit. Ops/legal needs to OK the MOU language.
Ops (RevOps): I can draft a simple MOU: credit applied as invoice credit, forfeited if they don't convert. Need customer billing contact and expected invoice date. CC: legal-review.
Maria (Finance): fine with $8k if it's documented as conditional credit on a signed MOU and we get billing contact. otherwise we cap at $5k non-conditional.
Elaine (Sales): I'll get billing contact and push the MOU. customer says their CTO wants a short term sheet tonight. rolling this: can we provision a temporary promo code `NEBULAX-EXT` for $8k but blocked for capture until MOU uploaded?
Jeremy (Deals): we can't apply $8k without the MOU. but we can reserve the code and set it to require manual capture. Ops — can you create a promo code in the console and set status = `reserved`?
Ops (RevOps): yup. I'll create `NEBULAX-EXT-2026` with amount $8,000, expiry 3 weeks from now, status reserved. I'll add a note referencing thread_ts=1898765432.
Sam (Solutions): once we have logs we can run the extra perf sweep. I can prep a small runbook for them (how to toggle KV prefix caching and adjusted batch sizes).
Elaine (Sales): perfect. thanks all — will loop in customer billing and upload MOU once signed. quick ask: if MOU delayed can we fall back to $5k auto-approved?
Jeremy (Deals): yes fallback = $5k auto. if MOU arrives within window, Ops will capture remaining $3k. if not, reserved code will expire.
Elaine (Sales): great. I'll update the thread with billing contact + attach MOU when signed. :thumbsup:
Ops (RevOps): promo created: code `NEBULAX-EXT-2026`, reserved $8,000, expires in 21 days. ping me when MOU uploaded and I'll capture.
Maria (Finance): noted. I'll flag for month-end reconciliation if captured.
Elaine (Sales): thanks everyone, closing loop — will drop final here.
